title: Khaemenes Mathematics Core
description: Universal mathematics templates for reasoning, proof, investigation, modeling, concepts, problem solving, error analysis, and revision across the Khaemenes mathematics continuum.

templates.title: Worked Example
templates.description: A worked-example framework separating givens, target, plan, visible work, checking, conclusion, and evidence type.

templates.title: Mathematical Reasoning
templates.description: A structured reasoning page for claims, known information, representations, logical steps, counterexample checks, conclusions, and mathematical status.

templates.title: Proof Framework
templates.description: A formal proof scaffold for statement, hypotheses, strategy, justified steps, theorem dependencies, conclusion, and proof review.

templates.title: Mathematics Error Analysis
templates.description: An error-analysis page identifying the first incorrect step, error type, mathematical cause, corrected work, verification, and transfer rule.

templates.title: Graph & Data Investigation
templates.description: A graph and data investigation for inputs, representations, observed features, calculations, interpretation, limitations, and result type.

templates.title: Mathematical Modeling Task
templates.description: A modeling framework for context, variables, assumptions, mathematical representation, work, interpretation, checking, limitations, and revision.

templates.title: Formula & Concept Organizer
templates.description: A concept reference for definitions, formulas or relationships, symbols, units, conditions, representations, examples, errors, and connections.

templates.title: Problem-Solving Journal
templates.description: A mathematical problem-solving journal preserving first ideas, representations, false starts, revisions, insights, current results, and next moves.

templates.title: Mathematical Vocabulary & Conjecture
templates.description: A vocabulary and conjecture page connecting precise definitions, examples, patterns, conjectures, tested evidence, counterexample searches, and status.

templates.title: Mathematics Assessment Correction
templates.description: A correction form connecting an original response to the identified issue, corrected reasoning, corrected result, verification, and learning note.
